input.subject: Science
input.about: Plants and how they make food
input.syllabus: Unit 3: photosynthesis, roots and stems, how water moves through a plant.

write.reason: The unit covers how plants make food and move water.

topics.title: How plants make food
topics.recall: Plants use sunlight, water and air to make sugar.
topics.example: A leaf in sunlight makes food.
topics.nonExample: Roots eat soil to get food.

questions.prompt: What three things does a plant need to make its own food?
Two plants are the same, but one sits in a dark closet for a week. Predict which one stays healthier and explain why.
questions.answer: Rubric: the plant in the light; it can keep making food because it gets sunlight.

topics.title: How water moves in a plant
topics.recall: Water goes in through the roots and travels up the stem to the leaves.
topics.example: A celery stalk in coloured water turns colour.
topics.nonExample: Water enters through the flowers first.

questions.prompt: Put these in order for water travelling through a plant: leaves, roots, stem.
Design a simple test to show that water travels up a stem. Say what you would see.
questions.answer: Rubric: puts a stem or celery in coloured water and observes the colour rising into the leaves.

items.answer: The one in light, it can make food.
